label: PCM1::JAK2

sections.text: PCM1 encodes a centrosomal-satellite scaffold protein.
JAK2 encodes a nonreceptor tyrosine kinase that transduces cytokine-receptor signals.
The fusion retains the JAK2 tyrosine-kinase region and removes normal amino-terminal control, producing constitutive JAK-STAT signaling. PCM1::JAK2 is associated with myeloid/lymphoid neoplasia.
Ruxolitinib responses have been described in small series of PCM1::JAK2- and BCR::JAK2-positive myeloid neoplasms; this is off-label fusion-directed evidence.
